- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (sentiment > 0.67) — reduce forecast peak values.
- Underestimate prices in bearish sentiment periods (sentiment < 0.33) — raise forecast lows.
- Overshoot after sharp sentiment spikes (e.g., sentiment jumps to 1.00) — cap forecast peaks at 10–15% below true peak.
- Lagged price movements (forecast lags true by 2–3 days) — adjust forecast to align with recent 3–5 day trend.
- Mean-reversion bias: if forecast is >10% above recent 7-day average, reduce by 5–8% unless sentiment supports continuation.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts overestimate volatility in early cycle (e.g., 1–5 days) — dampen early forecast growth.
- Sentiment-driven bias correction: if sentiment > 0.75, reduce forecast by 2–4% for each day beyond 10-day horizon.
